The existing `data/raw` directory is the pipeline's immutable input boundary.
This first target records which staged files exist, but does not open them.

::: {.manual-prereq title="Confirm Staging Authority"}

Prior meetings with GDN confirmed our data source. The two distinct batches
of clinical data are generally "from Symphonia," who is our
data management liaison from the government of Madagascar. We had
been storing this data on Google Drive, meaning our
staged data can come straight from the GDrive mirror. The path
is under CSPH Madagascar, under Health Data/Ntl Clinic Data.

Add the stagecoach manifest and use `targets::use_targets()` to put the
targets file in the repo.

Make sure that the targets file and the stagecoach manifest are ready and edited to have the
inputs ready and the targets file added with `tar_tangle(<NOTEBOOK>)`.

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Inventory Staged Files Without Reading Them"}

The root `_targets.R` tangles this assignment into the initial graph. It
observes paths only when the pipeline is explicitly executed.

```{r}
#| format: file
pipeline_stagecoach_manifest_path <- here("stagecoach_manifest.yml")
pipeline_raw_input_files_paths <- {

  stopifnot({
    file.exists(pipeline_stagecoach_manifest_path)
  })
  input_dir <- here::here("data", "inputs")
  if (!dir.exists(input_dir)) {
    stop("The staged-input directory is missing: ", input_dir)
  }

  input_paths <- list.files(
    input_dir,
    recursive = TRUE,
    full.names = TRUE,
    include.dirs = FALSE
  )
  if (!length(input_paths)) {
    stop(
      "No approved inputs are staged. Complete the human staging decision ",
      "before running the pipeline."
    )
  }

  input_paths
}
```

:::

::: {.manual-check title="Verify The Staging Boundary"}

```sh
test -d data/inputs
test ! -L data/inputs
```

Do not print filenames or file contents into Manual render logs.

:::
